Questions

Is Annual worth it?

On a single order of £360 or more, the 10% off covers the £36 fee. Smaller orders across the year can add up to the same, since the discount comes round every month.

What do I get for free?

Members’ area access, 5% off members’-area deals, Free delivery over £30, Loyalty points on every order.
